text:
jenna_events: quick sync  need to finalize webinar topic this week. shortlist: 1) "Resilient Inference: graceful degradation patterns" 2) "Cost-first serving: practical batch & cache tactics" 3) "Real-world rollouts: canaries, fallbacks, and SLOs" which resonates most for product-led audience?
ava_marketing: leaning into 1 + 3 combo. audience cares about reliability stories. want a punchy social hook.
sam_content: abstract idea draft: 2-3 lines: "When traffic spikes, your model should faildown, not fail out. We’ll demo live fallbacks, routing policies, and a postmortem-ready checklist for keeping LLM features online under load." ok?
mike_prod: love it. also suggest a short notebook download to follow the demo. primary demo: simulate noisy hosted API then route to dedicated pool then to quantized model.
tom_runtime: can demo latency vs token-cost tradeoff graphs. will prepare one for 16/32/64 seq lengths. need realistic seq distribution from product to match visuals.
leo_growth: inbound plan: register -> tag workload -> hands-on lab invite. can we add a checkbox on reg form asking "Which workload do you care about? (chat/search/embeddings)" to auto-segment?
diego_ops: logistics: prefer Tue 2026-05-12 or Thu 2026-05-14. greenroom 20m. I'll provision a demo sandbox with isolated quota + recording enabled. also will create a "demo safety script" to revert routes if something goes wrong.
jenna_events: run-of-show (40m + QA):
- 0:00-0:04 - intros
- 0:04-0:12 - customer vignette (12m)
- 0:12-0:28 - live demo (Mike + Tom) 
- 0:28-0:32 - infra patterns & ops checklist (Diego)
- 0:32-0:36 - playbook: cost vs latency decisions (Ava)
- 0:36-0:40 - wrap CTA to lab + resources
- 0:40-0:55 - audience Q&A
jenna_events: rehearsal plan: 
- dry run (full) Mon 5/11 10am PT
- tech check live day 5/12 9:40am PT
please confirm availability.
mike_prod: demo contingency items: 
- scripted response recorded video if live endpoints fail
- smoke test script: `./smoke.sh --demo`
- toggles: env var REDWOOD_TARGET=(hosted|dedicated|fallback)
we'll rehearse video fallback once.
ava_marketing: promo timeline: 
- 2 weeks out: announce + event page
- 5 days out: benchmark image + speaker quotes
- 1 day out: speaker mini bios + reminder
also plan small paid push 72-24h before.
sam_content: landing page microcopy (short): "Keep your LLM features online when it matters. Join engineering leaders for a hands-on session about routing, fallbacks, and cost-aware serving patterns. Includes demo notebook."
leo_growth: lead routing: tag mapping + SDR split: 
- chat -> SDR-A
- search -> SDR-B
- embeddings -> SDR-C
we'll export to Salesforce + trigger nurture flow.
diego_ops: checklist for greenroom (10 items): mic check, recording on, captions, demo sandbox health, rollback script ready, presenter screenshare permissions, moderator spotter, backup video clip, network monitor, calendar link in chat.
opsbot: calendar invite created for 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC by jenna_events.
jenna_events: action items: Ava - write ad copy + image by 5/1; Sam - landing page + abstract by 4/28; Mike/Tom - demo scripts + smoke tests by 5/6; Diego - sandbox + rollback script by 5/8; Leo - reg form + routing by 4/30. I'll consolidate and send invites. :rocket:
